name: Vera C. Rubin Observatory
description: A US NSF-DOE facility on Cerro Pachón with the 8.4 m Simonyi Survey Telescope and the 3.2-gigapixel LSST Camera. It images the whole southern sky every few nights.
highlights: The LSST Camera is described as the largest digital camera ever built.
Its ten-year survey is expected to catalogue millions of supernovae and more than five million asteroids.
